interpretation: One starting actor/fine-tuning seed and two maps: exploratory, not universal or statistically significant. Stable is compared with equal-budget control training; frozen v14 and original hybrid are baselines. Only the directional training reward differs; actor and critic retain identical conditioned 91D access. 16s primary and 64s secondary remain separate; secondary cannot override primary failure. Direction and posture means are conditional on visited valid states, not matched-state causal effects. Invalid direction samples are excluded, never counted as good tracking. Reward is unweighted and not dt-integrated. World-Z angular velocity is not Euler yaw derivative under tilt. Ideal ray depth and a kinematic swing proxy do not establish real-camera or robot safety.
